ov: A medium-sized antelope of eastern and southern Africa with a glossy reddish-brown coat. Only males have horns, slender and lyre-shaped, up to 92 cm long. It lives in herds in woodland near water and is active mainly by day.

why.et: Listed as a food source for people.

rg: Eastern and southern Africa; the black-faced impala only in southwestern Angola and northwestern Namibia.
df: Grasses, plus leaves, forbs, fruit and acacia pods.
fx: A territorial male’s roar can be heard up to 2 km away.
It seems to be the only hoofed mammal that grooms both itself and others.
